description: A script for communicating with Jungo-based routers to backup firmware and replace boot loader, including functions for flash dump, firmware upload, and router interaction via telnet.

methods.name: start_server
methods.description: Starts an HTTP server in a new thread for file serving.

methods.name: get_flash_size
methods.description: Determines the flash size of the router by reading system info via telnet.

methods.name: image_dump
methods.description: Performs a flash dump from the router and saves to a file.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.
